title: Electrical Estimate Template: Fill In, Download PDF, Word, Excel
description: Price panel upgrades, EV chargers and new circuits in your browser. No sign-up. Estimate with scope, exclusions, validity and deposit, plus sourced US ranges.
lede_html: This form writes an electrical estimate that you can send today as a PDF, Word or Excel file. It needs no account. The sample is a home EV charger. Change it to your job.

sample.scope: Add a 50 A, 240 V circuit from the main panel to the garage. Mount the owner-supplied Level 2 charger. Load calculation and permit included.
sample.exclusions: Panel upgrade if the load calculation fails. Charger hardware. Drywall patch and paint.
sample.terms: If the panel fails the load calculation, we send a written change order before any panel work.

labels.bizId: License no. (Florida: print it on the offer)

must_show.heading: What an electrical estimate should say
must_show.intro_html: A clear electrical estimate names the load, the panel plan and the permit, and it says what happens if the existing panel cannot carry the new load.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters before the job
rows: It decides whether the price holds.
A panel upgrade is the largest swing in a charger or addition job.
Name who buys the charger, fixtures or fan.
Say who pulls the permit and whether its fee is included.
Patch and paint are often excluded. Write that.
Copper and breaker prices move, so set a date.

example.heading: Filled example: 100 A to 200 A service upgrade
example.intro_html: A different job at sample prices. Use your own.

items.d: Master electrician: new service, meter can, panel

line_items.heading: Electrical projects and typical prices
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range comes from the source in the same row. The price that the button adds is a sample inside that range, not a price recommendation.

rules.heading: Rules to check before you send an electrical estimate

items.title: Florida: number on each offer
items.html: Florida Statutes 489.521 says that the registration or certification number must be stated in each offer of services, business proposal or advertisement. Check the section for your license type.

items.title: Permit first in Washington
items.html: Washington L&I says that electrical work requires a permit and inspection, with a few exceptions, so add the fee to the estimate.

items.title: Who does the work in Texas
items.html: Texas requires an electrical license under Chapter 1305. Name the licensed person or company on the estimate.

faq.q: Should I quote a panel upgrade inside a charger estimate?
faq.a: Give it as a separate option. Then the customer can accept the charger, and the upgrade only if the load calculation needs it.

faq.q: Do customers need separate pricing for parts?
faq.a: Not always. A lot price is simple. Show parts apart when your state taxes them apart from labor, and use the tax choice on the form.

faq.q: How much deposit should I ask for?
faq.a: It depends on the state and your material cost. Check your state before you enter the percent.

faq.q: What is the difference between an electrical bid and an estimate?
faq.a: A bid usually answers a request for a price on a defined scope. An estimate is your priced view of the job. Write the scope either way, and say if the price is fixed.
